item.text:
Reconstructed all 14 verses in Shahmukhi Panjabi and verified that they match the Roman transcription line for line in one stanza. Preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, moved the closing recitation credits to metadata, and removed the resolved `noUrdu` tag.

The Roman phrase “Kabay oon bar” is ambiguous. I rendered it as `کعبے اُوں بار` to stay close to the recorded pronunciation.
